events.name: Cinnabar Lab

remembers.notice: Dr. Yarrow has the paperwork. "Blackwood wrote. Nine pages. He wants to know everything it does."

events.intro: A white building on black rock. Inside, everything hums, and a man's asleep on a keyboard. Three rooms: Fossil Revival, the Fusion Display, and the Trade Wing.

success.text: The revival room is cold and very clean, with one plate in the middle of it like an altar.
Two tanks and a drawing of what would come out. An assistant: "We don't do it. We draw it. The drawing's the fun part. Nobody gets hurt by a drawing."
Three researchers look up from three desks at once. Each of them wants something common, and each has something that isn't.

choices.label: Leave him asleep on his keyboard.

success.text: You let the door close softly. Behind it the hum goes on, and so does the snoring.

events.name: Cinnabar Lab: It Wakes
events.intro: Something very old opens its eyes on a world with the wrong stars, and sees one face.

success.text: It looks at you for a long time. Then it decides to believe you. Its Bond starts one step higher.

effects.text: Woke a fossil at the Cinnabar Lab, and were the first face it saw.

success.text: It doesn't know the words. It knows the voice. Its Bond starts one step higher.

effects.text: Woke a fossil at the Cinnabar Lab, and were the first face it saw.

success.text: It puts its head under your hand, and leaves it there. Its Bond starts one step higher.

events.name: Cinnabar Lab: The Fusion Display
events.intro: Pick any two of your party, and the assistant sketches what would come out. Cosmetic: nobody gets hurt by a drawing.

choices.label: Pick two and watch her draw.

success.text: The sketch is very bad and very loving. Your lead looks at it, and then at you, with deep suspicion. You keep it anyway.
Back.

events.name: Cinnabar Lab
events.intro: Everything hums. The man on the keyboard has turned his head the other way.

success.text: The revival room is cold and very clean, with one plate in the middle of it like an altar.
Two tanks and a drawing of what would come out. An assistant: "We don't do it. We draw it. The drawing's the fun part. Nobody gets hurt by a drawing."
Three researchers look up from three desks at once. Each of them wants something common, and each has something that isn't.

choices.label: Leave him asleep on his keyboard.

success.text: You let the door close softly. Behind it the hum goes on, and so does the snoring.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion
events.intro: A great house with no roof. The fire was years ago. Grimer live in what was the kitchen. Burned-out ruins: Fire, Poison and Electric Pokémon, and a 1 in 16 chance of a burn from hot rubble at every room.

success.text: The front door is only half a door.
You leave the ruin to its Grimer.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Hall
events.intro: Two statues with red eyes. One's eye is a switch. Three statues in the house, and each one opens some doors and shuts others.

success.text: The hall is full of things that live in rubble now.

failure.text: The hall is full of things that live in rubble now. Hot rubble shifts underfoot and your lead is burned.

success.text: Something clunks deep in the walls, and a door you hadn't noticed stands open.

failure.text: Something clunks deep in the walls, and the wrong door slams shut. It takes another try to put it right.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Library
events.intro: Burned books. On the one desk, Diary page 1: "We found it in the jungle. A new kind. We've named it. It let us."

success.text: Something in the stacks objects to you reading.

failure.text: Something in the stacks objects to you reading. Hot rubble shifts underfoot and your lead is burned.

success.text: It let us. You read that line a third time.

effects.text: Read page 1 of the Mansion diary: a new kind, found in the jungle

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Laboratory
events.intro: Broken tanks. A second statue switch. Diary page 2: "It's had a child. We are calling the child Two. We're very proud. I'm ashamed of how proud." On the back of the page, in pencil, the order of the switches.

choices.label: Read the back of page 2, and press them in order.

success.text: Hall, laboratory, basement. Every door opens at once, the right ones.

effects.text: Read page 2 of the Mansion diary: the child called Two

success.text: Something clunks deep in the walls, and a door you hadn't noticed stands open.

failure.text: Something clunks deep in the walls, and the wrong door slams shut. It takes another try to put it right.

success.text: A Magmar has made a nest in the warm tank.

failure.text: A Magmar has made a nest in the warm tank. Hot rubble shifts underfoot and your lead is burned.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Nursery
events.intro: A small room. A cot. Toys for something that wasn't a child. Nothing lives in this room; nothing fights here. Diary page 3: "It asks questions now. We haven't taught it any. I answered one honestly and it didn't speak for a week."

success.text: You fold it into your notebook very carefully, as if it could still be hurt.

effects.text: Read page 3 of the Mansion diary: it asks questions

choices.label: Leave the page on the cot.

success.text: Some things should stay where they were left.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Basement
events.intro: The third switch, and the door it opens. Diary page 4: "We can't hold it. He says we must. He signs the cheques. He doesn't sign them with his name." Page 4 is a File: the cheques tie to Giovanni's cover.

choices.label: Take page 4, and open the door.

success.text: The file goes in your bag. The door opens on a light.

effects.text: Read page 4 of the Mansion diary: the cheques

success.text: Something clunks deep in the walls, and a door you hadn't noticed stands open.

failure.text: Something clunks deep in the walls, and the wrong door slams shut. It takes another try to put it right.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Scientist
events.intro: A Rocket scientist, left behind, with a Muk or a Weezing. The scientist: "I came back for my notes. That's all. I just want my name off them."

success.text: He fights like a man who wants it to be over.

failure.text: He fights like a man who wants it to be over.

success.text: "Not his. Never his." He says it to the floor. Then he looks up: "Battle me or let me go. I can't stand here."
No battle. He gathers his notes, and leaves the Secret Key on the table, and goes up the stairs without looking back.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: The Scientist
events.intro: He waits for your answer with his notes held against his chest.

success.text: He fights like a man who wants it to be over.
He leaves the Secret Key on the table.

events.name: Pokémon Mansion: What the House Gives
events.intro: The Secret Key opens the Gym's door, and one locked room in Cerulean Cave. And in the scientist's drawer: TM Fire Spin, or a Fire-type fossil.

success.text: The disc is warm, as if the fire never quite went out in it.

effects.text: Walked out of the burned Mansion with the Secret Key.

success.text: A fossil with a little warmth still in the stone.

effects.text: Walked out of the burned Mansion with the Secret Key.

events.name: Seafoam Islands
events.intro: Two islands joined underground. The sea goes in at one end and comes out the other, fast. An ice cave with a current: until a boulder is set, the current may carry you one room back. Three boulders, on the second, third and fourth rooms, each to be pushed into the hole on the level below.

success.text: The first room is all ice and spray, and a Seel who thinks you are in its way.
You leave the sea to its business.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The First Boulder
events.intro: The first boulder sits by the hole, and the current runs hard under it.

success.text: Your Pokémon puts its shoulder to the boulder and it drops into the hole on the level below. The current there breaks against it.

choices.label: Push it in with your lead: two pushes.

success.text: The first push moves it halfway. Something in the ice cave doesn't like the noise.
You keep your feet. Just. The current pulls at you the whole way, and lets go at the far side.

failure.text: Without the boulder the current is still running. It takes you off your feet and carries you one room back.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Second Boulder
events.intro: A Slowpoke's sitting on the second boulder. It doesn't move. It's noticed you. It'll have noticed properly by tomorrow.

success.text: You push. The Slowpoke rides the boulder all the way into the hole, and climbs out again, unbothered.
You wait. It takes a node's time. When it finally gets down, it follows you, and lets itself be caught without a fight.
It takes the Berry, and gets off, and the boulder goes in.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Third Boulder
events.intro: The last boulder. Beyond it the water goes still.

success.text: Your Pokémon puts its shoulder to the boulder and it drops into the hole on the level below. The current there breaks against it.

choices.label: Push it in with your lead: two pushes.

success.text: The first push moves it halfway. Something in the ice cave doesn't like the noise.
You keep your feet. Just. The current pulls at you the whole way, and lets go at the far side.

failure.text: Without the boulder the current is still running. It takes you off your feet and carries you one room back.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Still Water
events.intro: The current is broken. The sound of the sea has gone somewhere far away. One more room, and the bottom.

success.text: A Jynx is singing in the dark, and stops when it sees you.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Bottom
events.intro: It's the only thing down here that isn't moving. The current goes round it.

success.text: A pillar of ice, in still water.

failure.text: Not a bird. Dewgong: five of them, surfacing one after another, and none of them pleased.

win.text: Fought a Dewgong horde at the bottom of the Seafoam Islands.

events.name: Seafoam Islands: The Pillar
events.intro: On a pillar of ice in still water, something with long blue feathers. It can be caught, at low odds.

success.text: It opens its wings and the water freezes round your feet.

win.text: Met Articuno at the bottom of the Seafoam Islands.

failure.text: Its feathers are the wrong colour: violet, and the eyes are wrong too. A Galarian Articuno.

win.text: Met a Galarian Articuno at the bottom of the Seafoam Islands.

events.name: New Island
events.intro: A Dragonite lands with a letter, and waits for an answer. The letter: "You are invited, as one of a few trainers of promise, to the castle on New Island. A ferry leaves at dusk. The ferry will not run. Come anyway." A thunderstorm: rain throughout; Thunder never misses.

success.text: The Dragonite bows, and flies off ahead of you into the dark.
The Dragonite doesn't know how to say. It looks at the sea.
Declining ends it; nothing's lost. The Dragonite takes the letter back, very carefully.

events.name: New Island: The Letter
events.intro: The Dragonite waits, rain running off its wings.

success.text: It flies ahead.
It takes the letter back.

events.name: New Island: The Crossing
events.intro: The ferry isn't running. Your own Pokémon carry you through the storm: a timing course. The harbour mistress, in a cloak, watching: "The ones who get across are the ones who should."

success.text: You cross, soaked to the bone, every one of your Pokémon gasping on the far shore.

failure.text: You wake on the dock. "Your best Pokémon was scanned." Nothing's lost. Nobody on the dock remembers a castle.

events.name: New Island: The Hall
events.intro: A long table set for many; three other trainers who made it. A hooded woman who speaks as if reciting.

success.text: Nobody eats. The hooded woman leads you all deeper.

events.name: New Island: The Host
events.intro: The hood comes off. She's a missing nurse, and she blinks, and doesn't know where she is. The host speaks without a mouth: "You came through a storm because a letter flattered you. So did they."

success.text: The nurse holds your sleeve. You take her with you.

events.name: New Island: The Laboratory
events.intro: Tanks. Every Pokémon the guests brought is scanned, through the Balls, without being taken. Nothing of yours is removed.

success.text: Below, a floor like a stage.

events.name: New Island: The Clone Battle
events.intro: Copies of your own team: the same species, no items, no abilities, +10% to every stat, and they know your moves and use the best one against each matchup. Your lead looks at itself. Itself looks back. Neither wants to go first.

success.text: After two knock-outs on either side, the fighting slows. Both sides are tired. They're hitting themselves.

events.name: New Island: Both Sides Tired
events.intro: Both sides are tired. They're hitting themselves.

success.text: The battle's finished as a battle. The host says: "As I thought. Nothing in it." The Clone Core is left on the floor: once, copy one Pokémon's moves to another.
The copies stop too. They've nobody telling them to go on. The host leaves, taking the copies with it: "They're mine. I won't have them used. Not even by me." The Clone Core is left behind.

Off-screen, a white flash. You're on the floor. Both parties are round you. The host's silent for a long time. "...Why would you do that for something you could replace?" Then it leaves, taking the copies: "They're mine. I won't have them used. Not even by me." The Clone Core is left behind.

effects.text: Stood between your team and its copies on New Island.

events.name: New Island: The Rafters
events.intro: The castle is emptying. Something pink might have been watching from the rafters all along.

success.text: Something pink's been watching from the rafters all along. It can be tried for, once.

failure.text: Only rafters, and the storm going quiet outside.

events.name: New Island: Mew
events.intro: It hangs in the air, upside down, curious. Once.

success.text: It plays with you more than it fights.
It watches you go, and then it is gone.

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano
events.intro: The Center's out of burn medicine. The herb it's made from grows in one place. Nurse: "It's up there. It only grows where it's too hot to pick it. I'd go, but then who's here?" Three steps up; each has a 1 in 16 chance of a burn to your lead. A Fire-type in the lead takes none, and finds the path.

success.text: Hot stone, and the smell of sulphur, and the path climbing.

failure.text: A vent breathes out as you pass. Your lead is burned.

success.text: The nurse nods. "Somebody will."

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano: Halfway
events.intro: The ground is warm through your boots.

success.text: Hot stone, and the smell of sulphur, and the path climbing.

failure.text: A vent breathes out as you pass. Your lead is burned.

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano: The Last Step
events.intro: Nearly there. The air shimmers.

success.text: Hot stone, and the smell of sulphur, and the path climbing.

failure.text: A vent breathes out as you pass. Your lead is burned.

events.name: Cinnabar Volcano: The Herb Bed
events.intro: At the top, a Magmar, a Charmeleon or a Ponyta, sitting in the herb bed as if it's a garden.

success.text: It gets up out of the herbs, slowly, and shakes them off.

win.text: Climbed Cinnabar Volcano for the burn herb.

success.text: It watches. You take one handful. It lets you.

effects.text: Climbed Cinnabar Volcano for the burn herb.

choices.label: Trade it a Berry for a handful.

success.text: It takes the Berry, and moves over.

effects.text: Climbed Cinnabar Volcano for the burn herb.

events.name: Route 23: The Badge Check

remembers.notice: Fourth guard: "Rainbow. You pushed a wheelbarrow at Team Rocket. My sister was there. She can't tell it without crying."
Second guard, unprompted: "And Brock says the stew's never been better since."
Fourth guard: "Rainbow. Quiet one, that. Nothing wrong with quiet."

events.intro: Eight guards, one after another, on one road. Each checks one Badge, and each has heard one thing about you. First guard: "Boulder. ...You're the one who sat through Brock's stew? Brave." Eighth guard: "Earth. ...Go on. Nobody's checked that one in years. Nobody's had it."

success.text: Eight guards, eight Badges, eight small nods. At the end of the road the gate is open.

effects.text: Passed the eight guards on Route 23.

choices.label: Take the shortcut the sixth guard offers.

success.text: He opens a side door: "Six Badges by Stage 7. You've earned the short way round." It skips the first two rooms of Victory Road.

events.name: Victory Road

success.text: The short way round comes out past the first boulder.

remembers.notice: The sixth guard's side door is unlocked.

events.intro: A cave with a carved arch. Eight sockets in the arch. As you walk under, eight lights come on, one at a time.

success.text: The lights stay on behind you.

events.name: Victory Road: The Arch
events.intro: A trainer sitting just inside, boots off: "I've been in here a month. I'm not lost. I'm resting."

success.text: Past the resting trainer, the cave gets serious.

events.name: Victory Road: Boulder Puzzle 1
events.intro: One boulder, one plate.

choices.label: Push the boulder onto the plate.

success.text: The boulder grinds onto the plate, and a gate lifts.
The boulder grinds onto the plate, and a gate lifts. It takes long enough that something comes to see what the noise is.

choices.label: Look round the whole hall first.

success.text: There are more boulders here than the way through needs, and more plates. Somebody built this as a puzzle on purpose.

events.name: Victory Road: Back to Back
events.intro: Two trainers, back to back.

success.text: A double battle.

events.name: Victory Road: Boulder Puzzle 2
events.intro: Two boulders, two plates, one of them on the floor above.

choices.label: Push the boulder onto the plate.

success.text: Two boulders, two plates; the second one rolls the last foot by itself.
Two boulders, two plates; the second one rolls the last foot by itself. It takes long enough that something comes to see what the noise is.

choices.label: Look round the whole hall first.

success.text: There are more boulders here than the way through needs, and more plates. Somebody built this as a puzzle on purpose.

events.name: Victory Road: The Ledge
events.intro: A rest: a ledge with a view of every stage of Kanto you've crossed. The party sits.

success.text: Every road, every town, from up here, small and lit. Nobody says anything. Bond +1.

events.name: Victory Road: Boulder Puzzle 3
events.intro: The last boulder, and behind it, either a nest or a kennel.

choices.label: Push the boulder onto the plate.

success.text: The last boulder drops, and the wall behind it opens.
The last boulder drops, and the wall behind it opens. It takes long enough that something comes to see what the noise is.

choices.label: Look round the whole hall first.

success.text: There are more boulders here than the way through needs, and more plates. Somebody built this as a puzzle on purpose.

events.name: Victory Road: Behind the Boulder
events.intro: Behind the third boulder: the cave's one shaft of daylight.

success.text: Moltres, asleep on a ledge with the cave's one shaft of daylight on it.

failure.text: An Arcanine, old, guarding nothing in particular.

events.name: Victory Road: The Nest
events.intro: Moltres, asleep in the light. It can be caught, at low odds.

success.text: It wakes, and the light becomes fire.
You pass it on tiptoe.

events.name: Victory Road: The Kennel
events.intro: The old Arcanine lifts its head. It can be battled, or passed with a bow.

success.text: It fights the way old dogs fight: rarely, and well.
It lowers its head to you, and lets you go.

events.name: Victory Road: The Rival's Last Stand

remembers.notice: The rival walks out beside you.

events.intro: The exit. Daylight. Somebody's sitting in it. Rival: "I got here yesterday. I was going to go straight in. Then I thought: no. They'll come through here. I want that one first. Everything after this is strangers. This one's ours."

success.text: A full battle. Win or lose, at the end the rival gets up first. Rival: "Right. Go on, then. I'll be behind you. ...I'll be right behind you."

win.text: Fought the rival one last time at the mouth of Victory Road.

events.name: Cerulean Cave
events.intro: A cave mouth over the water north of Cerulean. There was always a man standing in front of it. He's gone. Strong wild Pokémon of every kind; no trainers. Nobody else has been let in.

success.text: The first thing in the dark is not friendly.
The water laps at the mouth of the cave. It will wait.

events.name: Cerulean Cave: The Deep
events.intro: Deeper. A locked door in the rock, and the way on.

choices.label: Open the locked door with the Secret Key.

success.text: A cot, the same as the one in the Mansion's nursery. It's been carried here, a long way, by something that didn't need to carry anything.
Something else lives down here.

events.name: Cerulean Cave: The Bottom
events.intro: It's standing in still water with its back turned. Mewtwo: "Another one. You've come to see if it's true. It's true. Now what?"

success.text: It can't be caught on this visit. It ends when it has seen enough. Mewtwo: "Enough. You fight like someone who'll stop when it's asked. That's rare. Go."

events.name: Cerulean Cave: Before Leaving

success.text: It turns round. It has heard about the castle.

remembers.notice: It knows you. It knows what you did on New Island.

events.intro: Mewtwo has turned its back again.

success.text: Mewtwo: "You didn't do it. Don't carry what isn't yours. I've enough for both."
Mewtwo: "Nobody's asked. ...Come back when I've an answer."
You leave the way you came, and the water closes over the sound of your steps.

events.name: Cerulean Cave: The Second Visit
events.intro: Mewtwo: "I've an answer. I'd like to see what it's like. Out there. With someone who stops when asked." It offers to come. No Ball's thrown unless you choose to; it steps into one.

success.text: It steps into it. The Kanto Secret.

effects.text: Mewtwo chose to come with you: the Kanto Secret.

success.text: It comes without one, and a Ball is only for the rules. The Kanto Secret.

effects.text: Mewtwo chose to come with you: the Kanto Secret.

events.name: Sabrina's Lament
events.intro: A flashback, at a quiet place on the road. A small girl who bent a spoon, and a room that went quiet.

success.text: The memory is not yours, and it leaves you holding it anyway.

events.name: Charizard Valley
events.intro: A canyon with a gate, and a woman on a Charizard above it, looking down. The warden, Liza: "Nobody's kept here. They come to get strong, and they leave when they are. Yours wants in? Or you do?"

success.text: Charizard 1: each one stronger. Between them you may rest, but not heal.

choices.label: Let it fight all three alone.

success.text: Your Charmander line asked to fight all three alone, and you let it.
Liza: "Come back when it asks."

events.name: Charizard Valley: The Second
events.intro: The second Charizard drops off the cliff and lands in front of you.

success.text: Charizard 2: each one stronger. Between them you may rest, but not heal.

events.name: Charizard Valley: The Third
events.intro: The third is the oldest, scarred across one wing.

success.text: Charizard 3: each one stronger. Between them you may rest, but not heal.

events.name: Charizard Valley: Liza
events.intro: Liza lands beside you. She gives you Charcoal, and looks at you a long while: half the time, she gives a Mega Stone too.

success.text: A Mega Stone, too.

effects.text: Beat the three Charizard of the valley.

failure.text: Charcoal, warm in the hand.

effects.text: Beat the three Charizard of the valley.

events.name: Pidgeotto's Farewell
events.intro: The flock again. Fearow now. Under them, a tree full of Pidgey and Pidgeotto, with nobody to lead them. Your Pidgeotto's out of its Ball before it's called. It looks at the tree. It looks at you.

success.text: It evolves in the air. It leaves the party. A Sharp Beak's left on the path. It will be back, once, when you need it most.

effects.text: Let your Pidgeotto go to lead the flock.

success.text: A battle with the Fearow.

win.text: Your Pidgeotto drove off the Fearow, and stayed.

success.text: It goes. A stage later it comes back, and goes again. It's the tree's, and it's yours. It's both.

events.name: Pidgeotto's Farewell: Both
events.intro: A Pidgeot lands in front of you on the road, and shakes out its wings.

success.text: It stays a while. No choice here loses it for good.

events.name: Bulbasaur's Gathering
events.intro: Every Bulbasaur for miles, walking the same way, in the dark, in silence. A clearing. A tree in the middle with one enormous bud. A hundred Bulbasaur in rings round it. They start to sway.

success.text: Four bars, and you hit them, and every bulb in the clearing opens at once. A Bulbasaur or an Ivysaur follows you out, with a Miracle Seed.

effects.text: Saw every bulb open at the Bulbasaur gathering.

failure.text: You lose the beat, and the bulbs stay shut. Nobody minds.

success.text: You watch until dawn. It is enough.
At the last bar, it stops. Everyone else evolves. It can choose not to. You're asked nothing; it looks at you, and decides: it stays as it is, and gains what it would've gained.
At the last bar, everyone evolves, and so does yours.

events.name: Haunter's Mansion

remembers.notice: It's the same Haunter, from Lavender. "It's got a house?"

events.intro: An empty house with every light on, and music. The door opens by itself. A banner: "WELCOME" and, under it, in a different hand, your name, spelled nearly right. A party thrown by ghosts who haven't had a guest in forty years. A Gastly serving drinks through the glasses. A Gengar at the piano. A Haunter, hosting, in a hat.

success.text: Three party games: musical chairs (the chairs move), charades (the Haunter's are all "ghost"), and a toast. Then the Haunter asks to come along.

effects.text: Stayed for a party forty years in the making.

success.text: It isn't. They're hurt. A battle, half-hearted.
They understand. A slice of cake, wrapped. It's forty years old. It's a Spell Tag.

events.name: Lapras's Song

remembers.intro: Singing, from the water. Your Lapras from Silph answers it. The young one follows her voice out to the herd. No escort's needed.

success.text: They sing to each other until the young one is gone over the horizon.

events.intro: Singing, from the water. One voice, with gaps left in it where other voices should come in. A young Lapras in a cove too small for it, singing out to sea. Nothing sings back.

success.text: You walk the shore and it swims beside you. A two-step escort along the coast, and one battle with Tentacool. At the end, far out: answering voices. It goes. It looks back once.

win.text: Took a young Lapras home to its herd.

success.text: It stops, astonished. It tries the song again with you in it. A two-step escort along the coast, and one battle with Tentacool. At the end, far out: answering voices. It goes. It looks back once.

win.text: Took a young Lapras home to its herd.

failure.text: Your voice cracks. It sings anyway. A two-step escort along the coast, and one battle with Tentacool. At the end, far out: answering voices. It goes. It looks back once.

win.text: Took a young Lapras home to its herd.

success.text: It lets itself be caught. It's quiet in the Ball. A Lapras with Water Absorb and Sing.

events.name: The Tournament Poster
events.intro: A poster on the wall: FIGHTING TOURNAMENT. ALL COMERS. P-1 GRAND PRIX. Somebody's drawn a moustache on the Hitmonchan.

success.text: You read every line. You're entered at the door, without the entry test.
The Hitmonchan's moustache watches you go.

events.name: Pidgey Rush
events.intro: A Pidgey and Rattata horde: six, one after another. A boy on a fence: "They do that. Run at them. They hate that."

success.text: Pidgey and Rattata, one after another.
Pidgey and Rattata, one after another.

win.text: Ran at a Pidgey rush, and it worked.

events.name: Pidgey Rush: Three More
events.intro: Three more come out of the grass.

success.text: Pidgey and Rattata, one after another.

win.text: Ran at a Pidgey rush, and it worked.

success.text: They scatter. The boy on the fence applauds.

events.name: The Cut Tree
events.intro: A small tree across a side path.

success.text: The tree comes down clean. Behind it: an item, and a quiet place to rest.
The tree comes down clean. Behind it: an item, and a quiet place to rest.
Without Cut, the tree's a rest of its own. A Caterpie's asleep in it. Nothing's lost.

events.name: The Tough Junior
events.intro: Junior Trainer Thomasina Stubbs: "I'm tough. Ask anybody. Ask my mum."

success.text: She is, in fact, quite tough.

win.text: Beat the toughest junior on the road.

events.name: The Fishing Contest

remembers.notice: Mr. Sprat is the judge, and he pretends he's never seen you.

events.intro: Five anglers on a pier. Three casts; the biggest catch wins a Super Rod.

success.text: Yours is the biggest by a hand. A Super Rod.

effects.text: Won the fishing contest on the pier.

failure.text: Yours is respectable, and not the biggest.

success.text: You watch them fish until the light goes.

events.name: The Stone Seller
events.intro: Stones at ×1.2: ₽2,400. He never goes above it.

success.text: He wraps it in newspaper.
He wraps it in newspaper.
He wraps it in newspaper.
He turns the tray round.

events.intro: Stones at ×1.2: ₽2,400. He never goes above it.

success.text: He wraps it in newspaper.
He wraps it in newspaper.
He never goes above the listed price. He tips his hat anyway.

events.name: The Stone Seller
events.intro: The best result: ×0.8, ₽1,600.

success.text: He wraps it in newspaper.

He turns the tray round.

events.name: The Stone Seller
events.intro: The best result: ×0.8, ₽1,600.

success.text: He wraps it in newspaper.
He wraps it in newspaper.
He never goes above the listed price. He tips his hat anyway.

events.name: The Stone Seller
events.intro: A man with a tray. Stones at ×1.2. Haggle, with the Honest Trade Card: a three-step offer game. Best result: ×0.8. Worst: the listed price. He never goes above it.

success.text: Three offers, three counter-offers, and he laughs and gives in.

failure.text: He holds firm at the listed price.

success.text: He turns the tray to you.
He doesn't call after you.

events.name: Cycling Road

success.text: You win by a wheel. A Quick Claw, since you already have the Voucher. Biker, losing: "You haven't even got a bell."

failure.text: Biker: "You haven't even got a bell."

events.intro: A long hill down. A race against three Bikers: a lane-switching game.

success.text: You win by a wheel. The Bike Voucher.

effects.text: Won the race down Cycling Road.

failure.text: They win, but only just. Biker, sneering anyway: "You haven't even got a bell."

success.text: It takes a long time. The view is lovely.

events.name: The Biker Gang
events.intro: Six Bikers across the road, Rocket patches under their jackets.

success.text: Three battles.
Their leader, a woman called Big Dot, talks engines for ten minutes and lets you through. No Heat change.
